verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm wires and real-time payments (RTP) as supported rails alongside ACH, checks, and international payments through one API, with account/transaction visibility. However, there is no mention of FedNow at all, and no per-rail documentation of specific capabilities (origination vs receipt, limits, cutoff times, rail-specific fields) — evidence is limited to generic marketing/docs snippets rather than API reference detail. missing for 10: FedNow support, per-rail capability documentation (origination/receipt distinctions, limits/cutoffs), and any API reference or independent corroboration beyond marketing pages.
